title: OpenEval: Benchmarking Chinese LLMs across Capability, Alignment and Safety
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmarking platform that evaluates Large Language Models (LLMs) across three primary dimensions: Capability, Alignment, and Safety. The Alignment and Safety components are explicitly designed to assess adherence to human values, including harmlessness and morality, and they benchmark ethical risks such as power-seeking, self-awareness, bias, and offensiveness using 13 dedicated datasets.
